Earn BTC rewards

Prosper aims to be decentralized, transparent, and community-driven. Token holders will shape the future of the ecosystem by voting, contributing ideas, and actively engaging in open discussions with other holders. Active participants are therefore rewarded for their involvement in the protocol. Rewards are periodically distributed to holders that actively participate in the protocol by voting and staking with their PROS tokens.

This one-month reward campaign is a preview of the functionality to come while we bring hashrate online in November.
